Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — POC readout is Thurs 3pm PT. Need final numbers + a clean up of open blockers so we can propose a license path.
Priya Nair: Got it. I'll pull the evaluation set results this morning. Do we want a single slide with top metrics + 1-2 highlight prompts? :thumbsup:
Sam Ortiz: yes, one slide for metrics, one for gaps, one for recommended next steps/pricing tiers. Keep it <5 slides.
Maria Gomez: FYI security questionnaire came back from the customer with two flag items: KMS integration details and retention policy. I pinged eng for specifics.
Jonas Berg: On KMS — we can offer bring-your-own KMS for Private and Dedicated. I'll paste the integration snippet in a sec.
Claire (SE): For the readout, can we show both qualitative examples and the eval metrics? Customer likes seeing specific prompt/response pairs. I can assemble 3 strong examples.
Alex Chen: Perfect. Also need concrete throughput/cost numbers. Sam — can you confirm tokens/sec and p95 latency under the POC load?
Sam Ortiz: Quick numbers from the test run last night:
```
- p50 latency: 110ms
- p95 latency: 420ms
- avg tokens/s: 85k
- cost/token (hosted config): $0.00012
- cache hit rate: 28%
```
Alex Chen: Thanks. Can you run one more canonical eval with the customer's 800 prompt set and drop results by EOD? That will be the official metric we show.
Priya Nair: Running now. Preliminary accuracy on their eval set (n=800): 89.3% intent match, 82.7% slot extraction F1. I will attach the confusion examples.
Maria Gomez: Legal asked for a short risk summary to accompany the readout. Flagging data residency and SLA carveouts for Dedicated vs Hosted.
Jonas Berg: KMS snippet — we use standard envelope encryption with customer-provided key (AWS KMS / GCP KMS). Integration steps:
1) customer creates CMK with encrypt/decrypt permissions
2) provide key ARN to us via secure intake
3) we configure in Private control plane and rotate per policy
(we will include this text in the security appendix)
Sam Ortiz: One more thing — we hit a tail-case rate limit on long prompts at ~2% of requests. Root cause looks like batching heuristic for >4k tokens. I've filed ENG-5123 with a mitigation: temporary rate window increase for the customer's Dedicated pool.
Claire (SE): For the expansion ask, I propose 3 options to present:
- Option A: Hosted Pay-as-you-go (low commitment, higher unit cost)
- Option B: Dedicated monthly commitment (predictable throughput + 20% unit discount)
- Option C: Private + support (enterprise terms + custom SLAs)
Alex Chen: Nice. Can someone draft a concise slide with recommended option and revenue ask? We should also include a 60/90/180 plan and success criteria for production (p95 < 500ms, cache hit >40%, eval accuracy >90%).
Priya Nair: Drafting the metrics slide now. If we hit >90% on the 800 prompts, I'll recommend green for production readiness.
Maria Gomez: I've drafted the security appendix and legal risk bullets. Will share before noon for review.
Jonas Berg: I'll add the KMS snippet and the on-prem network diagram to the appendix.
Sam Ortiz: Re-ran canonical eval — final numbers (official):
```
- intent match: 90.1%
- slot F1: 83.4%
- p95 latency (customer workload): 388ms
- tokens/s: 91k
- cost/token (dedicated config): $0.00009
- cache hit: 31%
```
Alex Chen: Great — those exceed our production thresholds except slot F1 needs a small lift. Proposed action: schedule 2-week prompt tuning + add lightweight reranker. Who owns the reranker prototype?
Claire (SE): I can own the reranker prototype with Eng support. Estimate 1 sprint to get an initial improvement.
Priya Nair: I'll prepare before/after eval plan for the prompt tuning + reranker. We can present projected lift and required SLOs.
Maria Gomez: Legal approves the appendix language pending a short note on audit logging cadence. I'll add that.
Alex Chen: Final items for the readout doc: 1) single page metrics, 2) appendix (security + KMS + network), 3) slide with recommended option + revenue ask, 4) execution timeline (60/90/180). Can everyone drop their final bits by 1pm PT tomorrow?
All: +1 / will do. :rocket:
legal-bot: Note: NDA document signed on 2026-02-14. Entry added to contract tracker.
Alex Chen: Thanks team — I'll assemble and run a quick dry run Wednesday 11am PT. See you then.
